name: Getting along well with roommates is an important part of college life.
trans: 与室友和睦相处是大学生活的重要组成部分。

name: We should take an active part in extracurricular activities to enrich our campus life.
trans: 我们应该积极参加课外活动，以丰富校园生活。

name: Joining student organizations helps us develop communication skills and team spirit.
trans: 参加学生组织有助于我们培养沟通能力和团队精神。

name: College students should learn to strike a balance between study and activities.
trans: 大学生应该学会平衡学习与活动。

name: Doing volunteer work not only helps others but also broadens our horizons.
trans: 做志愿服务不仅帮助他人，也开阔我们的眼界。

name: Taking a part-time job can help students gain practical experience and learn to manage money.
trans: 做兼职可以帮助学生获得实践经验并学会理财。

name: When we have psychological pressure, we can seek psychological counseling or talk with friends.
trans: 当我们有心理压力时，可以寻求心理咨询或与朋友交谈。

name: Following dormitory regulations and keeping the dormitory clean are basic requirements for college students.
trans: 遵守宿舍规定、保持宿舍整洁是对大学生的基本要求。

name: A harmonious teacher-student relationship is beneficial to both teaching and learning.
trans: 和谐的师生关系对教与学都有益。

name: We should pay attention to campus safety and avoid going out alone late at night.
trans: 我们应该注意校园安全，避免深夜独自外出。

name: Regular physical exercise can help us relieve stress and stay healthy.
trans: 定期体育锻炼可以帮助我们缓解压力、保持健康。

name: College is not only a place for learning knowledge but also a stage for improving our overall quality.
trans: 大学不仅是学习知识的场所，也是提高综合素质的舞台。

name: It is widely acknowledged that campus life plays an important role in students’ personal growth.
trans: 众所周知，校园生活在学生个人成长中起着重要作用。

name: There is no denying that good interpersonal relationships make campus life more enjoyable.
trans: 不可否认，良好的人际关系使校园生活更愉快。

name: As college students, we should take an active part in campus activities and strike a balance between study and life.
trans: 作为大学生，我们应该积极参加校园活动，并平衡学习与生活。

name: Only by communicating with others sincerely can we build harmonious relationships.
trans: 只有真诚地与他人沟通，我们才能建立和谐的人际关系。

name: Taking part in volunteer work and social practice enables us to gain practical experience.
trans: 参加志愿服务和社会实践使我们能够获得实践经验。
